axis_gmii_rx.summary: GMII/MII Ethernet receive to AXI-Stream: a 5-byte delay line strips preamble/FCS while a 3-state FSM emits payload, and an LFSR CRC-32 checks FCS to flag bad frames.

blocks.name: Receive FSM
blocks.description: Detects SFD, streams payload, checks FCS at end, waits after errors.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/WAIT_LAST controller: detects SFD, emits payload, handles errors.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Receive enable required to start a frame on SFD.

blocks.name: Receive delay line
blocks.description: Five-stage data/dv/er shift registers, MII nibble assembly, frame tracking.

anchors.name: gmii_rxd_d4
anchors.why: Tail of 5-stage receive data delay line feeding output and CRC.

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv_d4
anchors.why: Delayed data valid used for SFD detection and error handling.

anchors.name: gmii_rx_er_d4
anchors.why: Delayed receive error aborting payload into WAIT_LAST.

anchors.name: mii_odd
anchors.why: MII nibble phase; holds FSM and shifts delay line on odd cycles.

anchors.name: in_frame
anchors.why: Tracks frame presence for SFD-based start-of-packet detection.

anchors.name: clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable gating FSM advance and delay-line shifting.

anchors.name: mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode.

blocks.name: CRC checker
blocks.description: LFSR CRC-32 over payload compared with trailing FCS bytes.

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC-32 state, reset in IDLE and updated per payload byte.

anchors.name: crc_next
anchors.why: LFSR next CRC compared with received FCS bytes.

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Advances CRC state during payload.

blocks.name: AXIS output
blocks.description: Registered AXI-Stream output beats with last and error user bit.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload byte from delayed receive data.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid during PAYLOAD state.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker on dv drop or error.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Frame error flag (optionally with PTP timestamp) on last beat.

anchors.name: ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Captures PTP timestamp at packet start for tuser (parameter-gated).

blocks.name: Status outputs
blocks.description: Registered start-of-packet and bad frame/FCS pulses.

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet pulse after SFD detection.

anchors.name: error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Bad frame indication from rx_er or FCS mismatch.

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: FCS mismatch indication.

ungrouped_anchors.name: gmii_rxd
ungrouped_anchors.why: GMII receive byte (or MII nibble) entering the delay line.

ungrouped_anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv
ungrouped_anchors.why: Receive data valid; frames packets and ends payload when low.

axis_gmii_tx.summary: AXI-stream to GMII/MII transmitter: a 7-state FSM emits preamble/SFD, payload, minimum-length padding, LFSR-computed CRC32 FCS and inter-frame gap, with MII nibble splitting.

blocks.name: Transmit FSM
blocks.description: Sequences preamble, payload, pad, FCS and IFG; handles MII odd cycles.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Frame FSM: idle, preamble, payload, last, pad, FCS, IFG sequencing all outputs.

anchors.name: mii_odd_reg
anchors.why: MII odd-cycle flag holding FSM while upper nibble is sent.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag used to drop remaining input and extend IFG.

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Frame error from underflow or tuser, drives gmii_tx_er in FCS.

anchors.name: start_packet_int_reg
anchors.why: Delays start_packet pulse to the MII odd cycle.

anchors.name: clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable; when low FSM and outputs hold.

anchors.name: mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode.

blocks.name: Frame counters
blocks.description: Preamble/FCS/IFG byte pointer and minimum-length padding counter.

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Counts preamble bytes, FCS byte index and IFG cycles.

anchors.name: frame_min_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes to minimum frame length, drives padding state.

blocks.name: CRC32 generator
blocks.description: LFSR child computes CRC32 over payload bytes for FCS.

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 state, updated in payload/pad, emitted inverted as FCS.

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Enables CRC state update with LFSR output.

blocks.name: Output datapath
blocks.description: Registers payload byte and drives GMII/MII data, enable and error.

anchors.name: s_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Payload byte register feeding GMII output and CRC LFSR.

anchors.name: mii_msn_reg
anchors.why: Holds most significant nibble for MII second cycle.

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit data: preamble, payload, pad or FCS bytes.

anchors.name: gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: GMII transmit enable asserted throughout frame transmission.

anchors.name: gmii_tx_er
anchors.why: GMII error signalled during FCS when frame error flagged.

blocks.name: PTP timestamp
blocks.description: Optional timestamp capture at start of packet.

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: PTP timestamp captured at packet start; disabled by default parameter.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input AXI payload byte captured into s_tdata_reg.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input valid starts frame in idle and detects underflow in payload.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input ready driven by FSM during payload and frame drop.

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
ungrouped_anchors.why: End-of-frame marker moving FSM from payload to last state.

ungrouped_anchors.name: cfg_ifg
ungrouped_anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap length compared in IFG state.

ungrouped_anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
ungrouped_anchors.why: Transmit enable gating frame start from idle.

ungrouped_anchors.name: start_packet
ungrouped_anchors.why: Pulse marking SFD transmission/start of packet.

eth_mac_1g.summary: 1G Ethernet MAC wrapper: AXI-Stream TX feeds an axis_gmii_tx instance and an axis_gmii_rx instance produces AXI-Stream RX from GMII, with MAC control/pause logic generate-disabled here.

blocks.name: TX path
blocks.description: axis_gmii_tx converts AXI-Stream frames to GMII with preamble, padding, FCS, IFG

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: TX payload byte from AXI-Stream, forwarded to transmitter instance

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: TX AXI-Stream valid, passed to axis_gmii_tx input

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: TX ready backpressure returned from transmitter

anchors.name: tx_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker for TX stream

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit data bus from transmitter instance

anchors.name: gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: GMII transmit enable framing gmii_txd

anchors.name: tx_mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble vs GMII byte mode in transmitter

anchors.name: tx_clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable for transmitter datapath

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap length for transmitter

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables frame transmission in axis_gmii_tx

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Transmitter underflow error indication

blocks.name: RX path
blocks.description: axis_gmii_rx strips preamble/FCS from GMII and outputs AXI-Stream with error flags

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received payload byte output from axis_gmii_rx

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: RX AXI-Stream valid from receiver

anchors.name: rx_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker of received stream

anchors.name: rx_axis_tuser
anchors.why: RX tuser carries bad-frame flag per frame

anchors.name: gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive data bus into receiver instance

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: GMII receive data valid qualifying gmii_rxd

anchors.name: rx_mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble vs GMII byte mode in receiver

anchors.name: rx_clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable for receiver datapath

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables frame reception in axis_gmii_rx

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Receiver bad frame error indication

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Receiver CRC/FCS mismatch indication
